summary.name: FaceApp
summary.one_liner: FaceApp is an AI photo editor that edits faces in pictures, with filters for aging, retouching, makeup, hairstyles, beards, expressions, and object removal.
use_cases: Previewing an aged or future self in a photo
Retouching skin and evening out skin tone
Trying different beard, mustache or hairstyles
Removing photobombers or unwanted objects from photos
Changing facial expressions for fun photos
summary.what_it_does: The page presents FaceApp as a face editing tool with filters for retouching skin, a realistic makeover ("Impression"), virtual makeup, and added hair volume. Blog posts describe a Remover tool for deleting people and objects from photos, a beard and mustache filter, Emotions filters for changing expressions, hairstyle filters, and Fun filters. Press quotes on the page reference its aging filter. The page itself gives few technical details about how the features work.
notable: Aging filter that became widely shared on social media
Object Remover tool for removing photobombers and unwanted objects
Emotions filters for changing facial expressions
Beard, mustache and hairstyle preview filters
caveats: Pricing and paid tiers are not stated on the page
Supported platforms are not named on the page
Page is mostly marketing and press quotes with few technical details
